mapper.select: SELECT R.ROLE_ID, R.ROLE_NM, R.DESCRIPTION, R.USE_YN, R.REGIST_DT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM APP_USER_ROLE UR WHERE UR.ROLE_ID = R.ROLE_ID) AS USER_CNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM APP_ROLE_MENU RM WHERE RM.ROLE_ID = R.ROLE_ID AND (RM.READ_YN = 'Y' OR RM.WRITE_YN = 'Y')) AS MENU_CNT FROM APP_ROLE R ORDER BY R.ROLE_ID
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM APP_ROLE WHERE ROLE_ID = #{roleId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM APP_USER WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND USE_YN = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO APP_ROLE (ROLE_ID, ROLE_NM, DESCRIPTION, USE_YN, REGIST_DT) VALUES (#{roleId}, #{roleNm}, #{description}, #{useYn}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE APP_ROLE SET ROLE_NM = #{roleNm}, DESCRIPTION = #{description}, USE_YN = #{useYn}, UPDT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE ROLE_ID = #{roleId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO APP_ROLE_MENU (ROLE_ID, MENU_ID, READ_YN, WRITE_YN, REGIST_DT) VALUES (#{roleId}, #{menuId}, #{readYn}, #{writeYn}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
INSERT INTO APP_USER_ROLE (USER_ID, ROLE_ID, REGIST_DT) VALUES (#{userId}, #{roleId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT M.MENU_ID, M.MENU_NM, M.MENU_COURS, M.GRAD, M.UP_MENU_ID, M.ORDR, COALESCE(RM.READ_YN, 'N') AS READ_YN, COALESCE(RM.WRITE_YN, 'N') AS WRITE_YN FROM MENU M LEFT JOIN APP_ROLE_MENU RM ON RM.MENU_ID = M.MENU_ID AND RM.ROLE_ID = #{roleId} WHERE M.USE_YN = 'Y' AND M.GRAD >= 2 ORDER BY M.GRAD, M.UP_MENU_ID, M.ORDR
SELECT U.USER_ID, U.USER_NM, U.ADMIN_YN FROM APP_USER U JOIN APP_USER_ROLE UR ON UR.USER_ID = U.USER_ID WHERE UR.ROLE_ID = #{roleId} ORDER BY U.USER_ID
SELECT USER_ID, USER_NM, ADMIN_YN FROM APP_USER WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY USER_ID
SELECT UR.ROLE_ID FROM APP_USER_ROLE UR JOIN APP_ROLE R ON R.ROLE_ID = UR.ROLE_ID WHERE UR.USER_ID = #{userId} AND R.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY UR.ROLE_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO APP_USER_ROLE (USER_ID, ROLE_ID, REGIST_DT) VALUES (#{userId}, #{roleId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT RM.MENU_ID, MAX(CASE WHEN RM.READ_YN = 'Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS READ_YN, MAX(CASE WHEN RM.WRITE_YN = 'Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS WRITE_YN FROM APP_ROLE_MENU RM JOIN APP_USER_ROLE UR ON UR.ROLE_ID = RM.ROLE_ID JOIN APP_ROLE R ON R.ROLE_ID = RM.ROLE_ID AND R.USE_YN = 'Y' WHERE UR.USER_ID = #{userId} GROUP BY RM.MENU_ID
SELECT DISTINCT RM.ROLE_ID FROM APP_ROLE_MENU RM JOIN APP_ROLE R ON R.ROLE_ID = RM.ROLE_ID WHERE RM.MENU_ID = #{menuId} AND RM.READ_YN = 'Y' AND R.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY RM.ROLE_ID

SELECT U.USER_ID, U.USER_NM, U.EMAIL FROM APP_USER U WHERE U.USE_YN = 'Y' AND U.MAIL_YN = 'Y' AND U.EMAIL IS NOT NULL AND U.EMAIL <> '' AND ( U.ADMIN_YN = 'Y' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM APP_USER_ROLE UR JOIN APP_ROLE R ON R.ROLE_ID = UR.ROLE_ID AND R.USE_YN = 'Y' JOIN APP_ROLE_MENU RM ON RM.ROLE_ID = R.ROLE_ID WHERE UR.USER_ID = U.USER_ID AND RM.MENU_ID = #{menuId} AND RM.READ_YN = 'Y' ) ) ORDER BY U.USER_ID
